newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar down, prices consolidate.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar down, prices consolidate.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures retreated from the contract highs hit during the previous session amid mixed selling and a dearth of buying by the funds, trading sources said.
The benchmark July contract fell to a low of 11.33 cents, barely under Wednesday's low of 11.34, where trade buying stymied further losses.
October also dipped barely under Wednesday's low of 11.16, to 11.15 cents, where dealers expect the contract to find near-term support.

At 1138 EDT, the benchmark July contract stood 0.10 cent lower at 11.41 cents per lb, having traded from 11.46 cents to 11.33 cents. October was down 0.10 to 11.22 cents, while the rest of the board stood 0.10 to 0.05 cent weaker.
Analysts expect the market to retrace recent gains ahead of the expiry of July options on June 15, and the futures contract, on June 30.

The Commitment of Traders Report released after the close on Friday is expected to show the speculators to be holding an extremely heavy net long position, which could put pressure on the market, traders said.
"Open interest is up and we know the funds have been active buyers recently," a broker said.

In the longer term, the fundamental situation could provide fuel for a rally, analysts said. The U.S. Department of Agriculture on Friday raised world consumption by about 2 percent while keeping global output flat, in 1997/98.
In addition, traders expect imports to China to increase over the next year.
Support was seen from 11.20 to 11.00 cents basis July.
An estimated 10,988 lots changed hands as of 1100 EDT.
